title: Entropy credit is conditional on a geometric edge-overlap decoder
statement: At R200,d132,K265,M600, four d-box Ferrers partitions have acquired positive law p_C=q^A/Z^4, with Gaussian-binomial recurrence O(d2) arithmetic. Actual monotone physical additions, conjugated top-corner profiles and first-majority stopping define channels. Proposed quadratic multiplicity2(d+1)^2=35378 includes direction/translation decoding; Cauchy then gives core resistance<=B_d*R_bare/(nZ4). Paths are not assumed disjoint. Exact small conservation/enumeration support, but do not prove, the general geometry/overlap and original-source dependencies; the package labels the claim conditional.
